established: The immutable sidecar stores 60 rectangular digit grids under the top-level targets field, so the prior target_token_ids_by_episode interface was incompatible with the actual frozen asset and could not support teacher-forced token scoring.
The proposed local scorer correctly narrows the stage to exact-grid scoring of the already frozen 360 prediction rows and requires exact raw-evidence and sidecar SHA256 identities before scoring.

Every frozen Greedy record must reconstruct to its saved canonical prediction SHA256 under the already verified native grid token contract. The single frozen alternate is parsed without target-guided repair, and an invalid alternate is counted as incorrect.

Greedy Top-1 is exact-grid equality of the frozen Greedy output. Frozen-branch Top-2 coverage is exact-grid success by either Greedy or the single previously frozen target-blind alternate; alternate-only recovery is retained separately.

The scorer writes booleans and canonical hashes rather than target grids, performs no model load, GPU operation, generation, training, backward pass, optimizer step, or candidate selection, and keeps Gold, dGold, and FINAL_AUDIT closed.
limits: This is reused synthetic development-cohort evidence, not independent ARC generalization confirmation.
The frozen-branch Top-2 metric covers one specifically frozen target-blind alternate and must not be represented as exhaustive model Top-2 or Beam-2 performance.

Exact-grid outcomes do not establish correct-token rank, target-token margin, likelihood, or a causal training mechanism. Those GPU-dependent measurements remain NOT_RUN and outside this authorization.
scientific_assessment.interpretation: The CPU-only correction is scientifically valid and has higher immediate information value than attempting to force the grid sidecar through the incompatible token-continuation interface.
